verdict.rationale: vLLM installs via pip/uv and runs as a headless OpenAI-compatible API server with streaming and tool-calling support, all of which are naturally scriptable/CI-friendly (vllm-gh-1, vllm-docs-9, vllm-docs-6). However, there is no explicit documentation or example of running vLLM in a CI pipeline, no CI/CD integration guide, and no community evidence confirming automated headless workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation or examples, first-party guidance on headless batch/non-interactive usage, and independent confirmation of CI usage.
